verdict.rationale: An email-delivery SaaS could plausibly offer natural-language operation, such as an AI assistant or agent interface, so this axis applies. The pack shows no such capability. It documents only REST APIs, SDKs, SMTP and dashboards. The llms.txt and markdown-docs probes make the docs readable by LLMs and mention Twilio's conversational AI building APIs, but they are adjacent and do not let a user operate SendGrid with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
